notes: The driver's sigkill step kills the claude PID six seconds into a long turn, so no turn-end signal is ever written and the transcript freezes mid-turn. The verdict is TierProcess, not transcript-tier: retainAsProcessDeath reads the OS view of the PID and session.SessionState.DiedMidTurn fails closed on its clauses. NOTE (#1817): this recording predates lifecycle.KindProcessDiedMidTurn, so its events.jsonl carries no process event and the offline replay cannot reconstruct the working->error edge; the golden's extended_check still reports missing_kinds [working->error] until the cell is re-recorded. The row must be RETAINED as error rather than reaped — that is what distinguishes this cell from 1.2 session-end, whose SIGKILL variants are supposed to disappear. Supersedes .specs/agent-scenarios-candidates.md candidate 23, which predates the error state and expected `ready`; painting a crash green is the defect #1796 exists to fix.
